nodes.content: Design a distributed query-result cache preserving transaction snapshot semantics across concurrent writes, range predicates, and replica lag.
requirements: Every cached result must match uncached execution at the transaction’s snapshot, including during failover.
Reduce p95 read latency 30% versus uncached execution at 80% reads and 20% writes.

nodes.content: Cache versioned results with key/range dependencies; reuse after indexed consensus-log conflict checks and replica catch-up to snapshot.
How can failover nodes verify range-predicate conflicts for long-lived snapshots after the consensus log is compacted?
A replicated, checkpointed interval-write index plus cache eviction at its retention cutoff yields zero missed range conflicts across 10,000 failovers.
Persist interval-write checkpoints, evict cache entries predating retained history, and test 10,000 failovers with MVCC-pinned range snapshots.
Run FailoverRange-10k, comparing cached and uncached MVCC results across 10,000 failovers, log compactions, concurrent inserts, and replica lag.
FailoverRange-10k report containing per-snapshot result diffs, range-conflict traces, compaction boundaries, replica lag, and failover timestamps.
Audit FailoverRange-10k report for snapshot mismatches, missed range conflicts, and cache hits below checkpoint retention across failovers.
FailoverRange-10k audit found zero snapshot mismatches or missed range conflicts across 10,000 failovers; all pre-cutoff entries were evicted.
Replay the report’s longest snapshot-to-compaction windows with 2-second replica lag; compare checkpointed range-conflict detection against uncached MVCC.
In long-window replay, 2-second replica lag exposed checkpoint gaps: 3/10,000 failovers missed inserts, returning stale cached range results.
Require contiguous cached-version-to-snapshot interval-write coverage and replica catch-up; bypass gaps to prevent the three observed failover mismatches.
Replay FailoverRange-10k checkpoint-gap traces under 2-second lag, comparing original and contiguous-coverage-gated caches against uncached MVCC.
With atomic checkpoint publication, index-plus-eviction missed zero conflicts across 10,000 failovers; without it, the three gap failures recurred.
Despite replica catch-up, coverage-gated replay returned three stale ranges: prematurely published checkpoint watermarks concealed missing interval writes.
Replay FailoverRange-10k gap traces under 2-second lag, atomically publishing checkpoint manifests; compare gated hits with uncached MVCC.
Atomic checkpoint manifests eliminated premature watermarks; coverage-gated replay matched uncached MVCC on all 10,000 failovers under 2-second lag.
Adopt contiguous-coverage gating only with atomically published checkpoint manifests; premature watermarks caused three stale results, while atomic replay had none.
Add snapshot-aware L1/L2 read-through caching with reuse-based admission and single-flight fills to target 30% lower p95 latency.
Does snapshot-aware L1/L2 caching offset validation and fill overhead enough to cut p95 read latency 30% at 80/20 load?
Reuse-admitted L1/L2 caches with single-flight fills and coverage validation cut p95 read latency ≥30% versus uncached at 80/20 load.
Run Mix80-20 comparing uncached reads against coverage-validated L1/L2 caching with reuse admission and single-flight; record p95 latency and snapshot mismatches.
Mix80-20 p95 reads: 100 ms uncached versus 79 ms cached (21% gain); snapshot mismatches: zero.
Profile Mix80-20 p95 hits by cache tier, validation RPC, and fill waits to explain the 21%-versus-30% shortfall.
Mix80-20 profiling attributes 13 ms of 79 ms p95 to serial validation RPCs; parallelizing them projects 69 ms.
Can parallel validation RPCs remove the 13 ms bottleneck without accepting stale checkpoint coverage during failover?
Parallel validation pinned to one atomic checkpoint-manifest epoch and replica catch-up achieves Mix80-20 p95 ≤70 ms, zero mismatches.
Pin parallel validation RPCs to one manifest epoch; rerun Mix80-20 with failovers, measuring p95 latency and cached-versus-uncached mismatches.
Run Mix80-20 with epoch-pinned parallel validation and 2-second replica lag; compare p95 reads and snapshot mismatches against uncached.
Mix80-20: epoch-pinned parallel validation cut read p95 from 100 to 69 ms (31%); zero mismatches during 2-second-lag failovers.
Mix80-20 high-churn rerun (80/20): overall read p95 was 84 ms cached versus 100 ms uncached, only 16% faster.
Defer rollout: parallelizing 13-ms validation raised baseline gains from 21% to 31%, but high-churn’s 16% requires admission tuning.
Admit query shapes after three conflict-free reuses; bypass volatile ranges with uncached snapshot reads while retaining epoch-pinned validation.
Can three-reuse admission and volatile-range bypass lower high-churn Mix80-20 read p95 from 84 to ≤70 ms?
Admitting after three conflict-free reuses and bypassing ranges exceeding 5 writes/s yields high-churn p95 ≤70 ms, zero mismatches.
Implement three-reuse admission and >5-writes/s range bypass; rerun high-churn Mix80-20, measuring read p95 and snapshot mismatches during failover.
Run high-churn Mix80-20 with three-reuse admission, >5-writes/s bypass, epoch-pinned validation, and 2-second-lag failovers.
HighChurn-Mix80-20 report with read-p95 comparisons, admission and bypass decisions, snapshot diffs, and failover lag traces.
Audit HighChurn-Mix80-20 p95 latency and snapshot diffs; correlate admission and >5-writes/s bypass decisions with failover lag.
HighChurn-Mix80-20 audit: read p95 fell from 84 to 68 ms (100 ms uncached); zero snapshot mismatches across failovers.
Adopt three-reuse admission and >5-writes/s bypass: high-churn read p95 reached 68 ms versus 100 ms uncached, without mismatches.
Validate cached cross-shard joins against transaction-consistent snapshot vectors and durable commit decisions before reuse after failover.
Can cross-shard join hits remain snapshot-correct when failover interrupts a distributed commit between participant acknowledgments?
Shard-epoch-pinned snapshot-vector coverage plus durable commit-decision proofs, bypassing unresolved transactions, yields zero join mismatches across 10,000 interrupted-commit failovers.
Replay HighChurn-Mix80-20 report’s lag traces through 10,000 interrupted-commit failovers; compare epoch-pinned, proof-gated cached joins with uncached snapshots.
InterruptedCommit-10k: epoch-pinned, proof-gated joins matched uncached snapshots across 10,000 failovers; 412 unresolved commits bypassed caching, zero mismatches.
Can proof-gated cross-shard joins retain ≤70 ms read p95 under high-churn Mix80-20 despite unresolved-commit bypasses?
Batching commit-proof lookups per snapshot vector keeps proof-gated high-churn Mix80-20 read p95 ≤70 ms, with zero snapshot mismatches.
Replay HighChurn-Mix80-20 lag traces with batched proof lookups and interrupted commits; measure read p95 and snapshot mismatches.
Batched HighChurn-Mix80-20 reached 69 ms read p95 with zero mismatches; interrupted-commit-heavy 80/20 joins reached 92 ms versus 100 uncached.
Replay HighChurn-Mix80-20 lag traces across 10,000 interrupted-commit-heavy failovers; compare proof-gated joins with uncached snapshots and dissect 92-ms p95.
Across 10,000 interrupted-commit-heavy failovers, two cached joins mismatched uncached snapshots after coordinator epoch rollover; read p95 was 92 ms.
Defer cross-shard join caching: initial failovers passed, but epoch rollover caused two mismatches and commit-heavy p95 reached 92 ms.
